pages.name: Design a campaign people can follow

elements.text: Design a campaign people can follow
Make each touchpoint useful and give people a reason to return.
What does the observed work tell us?
Which assumption could change the plan?
What evidence would justify the next step?

pages.notes: DSH-authored thesis composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Asymmetric argument with three supporting evidence rows

pages.name: Give each moment a distinct purpose

elements.text: Give each moment a distinct purpose
Schematic frames describe content and intent; they are not product screenshots.

pages.notes: DSH-authored storyboard composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Three schematic frames with distinct content and intent

pages.name: Locate the friction along the journey

elements.text: Locate the friction along the journey
Independent stage success rates. Inspect the weakest handoff first.

pages.notes: DSH-authored journey composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Four stages aligned across actions and independent outcome measures

pages.name: Separate the record from the explanation

elements.text: Separate the record from the explanation
The next owner was not visible.
The task itself may be unfamiliar.
Name the owner; repeat the same task.
Keep the observation, alternative explanation and next test separate.

pages.notes: DSH-authored evidence composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Interview excerpt, observation, competing explanation and next check

pages.name: Follow one cohort through the funnel

elements.text: Follow one cohort through the funnel
Column height follows cohort size only schematically; printed counts are authoritative.

pages.notes: DSH-authored funnel composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. A single cohort with explicit conversion counts and an overall rate

pages.name: Choose the next move with evidence

elements.text: Choose the next move with evidence
A / PRIORITY MAP · IMPACT INCREASES UPWARD
Decision: test B first; keep the other candidates visible until the evidence changes.

pages.notes: DSH-authored matrix composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Two-axis decision map with direct labels and a recommended next step

pages.name: Design the test before reading the resul

elements.text: Design the test before reading the result
Make each touchpoint useful and give people a reason to return.
A clearer next step reduces hesitation.
Same task; current vs revised guidance.
Adopt only if the agreed targets hold.
Set success criteria before collecting results. Record contrary evidence.

pages.notes: DSH-authored experiment composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. One hypothesis with comparison, measure and a predeclared decision rule

pages.name: A small intervention, a measurable chang

elements.text: A small intervention, a measurable change
A six-week pilot with a matched task definition.
Top bar: before. Bottom: after. Illustrative comparison, not a causal claim.

pages.notes: DSH-authored case composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Intervention narrative beside paired before and after comparisons

pages.name: Show how the judgment develops

elements.text: Show what changed between milestones, not just when an event happened.

pages.notes: DSH-authored timeline composition. All new example statements and figures are illustrative, not reported facts. Replace them with user evidence. Alternating milestone notes around a continuous argument timeline

Gate / W6: agree on evidence, owner and rollback conditions before expanding.
